concept: A quiet, contemplative stop-motion dialogue between a frog and a wise turtle on a paper pond, ending on a subtle moment of silent understanding.
style_bible: Layered paper-cutout stop motion photographed on a tabletop diorama rig. Built from cold-press cardstock with visible paper tooth, textured kraft paper, translucent vellum, and matte coloured stock. Every paper layer stands physically separate with soft contact shadows. Cut edges are hand-cut with craft knives, crisp but slightly irregular with pale paper cores showing along cut lines. Animation is stepped on twos. The recurring cast consists of: (1) a compact tree frog puppet cut from moss-green textured cardstock with a sage-green belly plate, glossy black pin-head bead eyes, dark brown ink outlines drawn inside the cut edges, and brass-split-pin joints at shoulders and hips; (2) a wise box turtle puppet cut from dark olive cardstock with a tall domed shell built from layered ochre yellow and umber brown paper plates, pale grey paper neck, wrinkled paper eyelids over black bead eyes, and brass-split-pin neck joint. The pond world features dark blue paper water, forest green paper lily pads with raised paper veins, and forest green and dark blue paper reed cutouts stacked in depth planes. Palette: moss green, sage green, dark olive, ochre yellow, umber brown, forest green, dark blue. Single light rig: warm key light from upper left at 45 degrees raking across paper surfaces, cool fill light from lower right. Vertical 9:16 portrait framing.
